title: Enforce Unique Semantic Emojis Across Repository
description: Every single entity MUST have a unique emoji among the siblings inside the same parent. No white space after the emoji. Add emojis to Technologies, Bundles, Folders (AGENTS.md frontmatter), Files (header description), Sections (region names), Definitions (docstring). Adjust repo implementation, tests, and extend all entities and source code.
summary: Defined schema-first repository path-emoji statutes, added TypeScript and Go enforcement with language-neutral tests and Unicode oracle validation, migrated 6,256 file/directory paths, repaired active references and Cargo targets, and verified zero missing, generic, presentation, spacing, or duplicate sibling emoji breaches across 77,399 governed entries.
